Learn more at sunfarmer.org

name: Nira Energy

long_description:
Charge Robotics is building robots that automate the most labor-intensive parts of solar construction.

Solar has rapidly become the cheapest form of power generation in many regions. Demand has skyrocketed, and now the primary barrier to getting it installed is labor logistics and bandwidth.

Our robots remove the labor bottleneck, allowing construction companies to meet the rising demand for solar, and enabling the world to switch to renewables faster.
name: Charge Robotics
one_liner: Robots that build solar farms

long_description:
SmartHelio provides a software that helps solar utilities automatically predict and prevent downtime disruptions. We help solar utilities to generate extra $200k per plant income on $10k spent using our software, by preventing 700 faults per year.

We have a platform which reads live data (current, voltage, weather parameters) from a solar plant, runs algorithms to decouple various factors for the underperformance and provides recommendations to fix it. This data is 100% available for the large scale solar in the world just using software (e.g. APIs). 

Product launch: https://www.producthunt.com/posts/heliocloud

Our cloud software is being used by 40+ leading solar developers in Europe and Asia. We have analyzed 25+ billion of  data points from over 3 GW of solar assets spread across the globe in the last 2 years.
name: SmartHelio
one_liner: Software to prevent downtime in a solar plant

long_description:

Coperniq does all this and much more in one beautiful platform!

Are you or someone you know running or thinking about starting a solar company? [Schedule a call with us :)](https://calendly.com/coperniq-sales/discovery-web-v2 )

We've reviewed and identified over 1 million zoning, permitting, and project-related documents in nearly every jurisdiction in America, so that you can instantly identify project requirements, local sentiment, and fatal flaws in seconds.

We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing. Our team combines leadership experience from AI and energy (Microsoft, Apple, Department of Energy, Brex).

long_description:
Plume is an AI-powered geospatial platform for site selection in energy infrastructure projects. 

Selecting the right sites requires analysis of +50 geospatial, grid, and regulatory constraints across fragmented data sources. 

Plume changes the process by enabling users to interact with geospatial data using natural language.

long_description: Astro finds and buys land for new renewable energy projects, secures grid connections at minimal cost, and sells these development-ready projects to larger energy companies. Founded by Alex Fuster, a former Citadel energy trader, Astro's AI models identify profitable grid connections that eliminate the surprise costs causing 80-90% of renewable projects to fail. With the U.S. needing 2,000 gigawatts of new power generation by 2035 for AI data centers and electrification, Astro unlocks development opportunities that traditional methods consistently miss.
name: Astro
one_liner: The world’s first AI energy developer

long_description:
The best grid connection is no grid connection. Voxel builds vertically integrated energy generation and storage systems for data centers that bypass utility connection delays. 

By leveraging the vast supply of second-life EV batteries and our novel DC microgrid architecture, Voxel generates datacenter power on site and drastically reduces system cost and time-to-power.
name: Voxel Energy
one_liner: Energy independent data centers with solar and repurposed batteries.

long_description:
Micora builds a solar-farm-in-a-box that can be shipped anywhere and built without specialized labor. We have designed a new type of solar farm micorgrid that is palletized, lightweight, and deployable. Our system autonomously builds 100kWp of capacity per day and is easily scalable to MWs of capacity which is a size currently only serviced by slow moving and at capacity EPCs. 

As demand from data centers, advanced manufacturing, and electrification strains existing power infrastructure, the ability to deploy substantial generation quickly is becoming increasingly valuable and unavailable. We are the only company that services utility-scale power needs in weeks.
name: Micora
one_liner: Microgrids in a box built anywhere in days

long_description:
The next constraint is not intelligence, it is the energy and operational cost of running it.
We deploy custom AI models inside critical infrastructure companies that ingest SCADA data, work orders, human interventions,  operational data no public model has seen, grounded in physics-informed neural networks and differentiable simulators. 
This creates a flywheel: more operator data → better process understanding → more efficient operations → cheaper energy → cheaper AI → more deployment → more data. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0uDH6pMn5OE

AI compute doubles every 2.2 years. Data center demand grows from 415 to 945 TWh by 2030. Without near-zero energy cost, AI remains limited by human infrastructure. We are the layer that runs AI at zero energy cost.
Energy is a $10 trillion market. The infrastructure layer doesn't exist yet. 
We are building it.
name: Invertix
one_liner: Energy Superintelligence, AI that operates critical infrastructure
